Definition: Lord, master and sir — the title used for God in the Greek Old Testament and confessed of Jesus as divine Lord.
BiblicalUsage: Kurios renders God's covenant name in the Septuagint, so calling Jesus kurios is explosive: 'Jesus is Lord' is the church's first creed, and every tongue will one day confess it.
TheologicalSignificance: Kurios settles the question of who is in charge — and it is good news. The Lord who anchors our hope is Jesus, exalted, reigning and returning.
RelatedEvents: The Resurrection; The Conversion of Paul
